verdict.rationale: Terminal offers an API-based, server-driven integration with a built-in simulated card reader, so it can be developed and tested without physical hardware. The Stripe CLI lets you build, test, and manage the integration from the command line, and webhooks let automation react to events. Together these support headless, automated use. Missing for 10: explicit CI-pipeline documentation or examples for Terminal, details on scripting the simulated reader non-interactively, and independent or hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use.
